source.quote: The table below presents the company's employees and related workforce at December 31, 2025. (In thousands) For the year ended December 31: 2025 IBM/wholly owned subsidiaries 264.3 Less-than-wholly owned subsidiaries 8.7

payroll.label: annual total compensation of the median employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), Pay ratio
source.quote: The ratio of the Chairman, President and CEO's annual total compensation to that of the median employee's annual total compensation is 765:1. This ratio is based on annual total compensation of $37,989,685 for the Chairman, President and CEO (as reported in the Summary Compensation Table) and $49,630 for the median employee.

notes: Employees: IBM reports its workforce in thousands at December 31, 2025: 264.3 thousand at IBM and wholly owned subsidiaries (used here), plus 8.7 thousand at less-than-wholly owned subsidiaries and a 13.8 thousand complementary workforce (an approximation of full-time equivalents hired under temporary, part-time and limited-term arrangements), which are not added. Payroll: the FY2025 10-K and Annual Report disclose no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median is used; it is the 2025 median (identified October 1, 2025 using annual base pay, all currencies converted to U.S. dollars; the median employee's base salary was $48,001).
